exceptions.reason: No verified patched release is available. The high-severity finding affects picomatch 4.0.7 in the build-tool dependency tree. Version 2.3.2 is used only by the Markdown linter and is included because this audit still checks the whole tree. Exploitation requires an attacker-controlled glob pattern; the reviewed build path uses trusted repository configuration. Checked against the CISA Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalogue on 2026-11-17 with no entry found.
exceptions.removeWhen: A published stable picomatch version is outside the advisory's current affected range and newer than at least one recorded version, or the matching advisory or exact installed vulnerable-version set changes.
